title: Perils Carried by Each ShieldCare Plan
content:
Whether a loss reported on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is a peril the plan carries
is read from this table. Each entry is a switch on the plan: carried, or not carried.

| Peril or exclusion | Essential Parts and Labour | Accidental Damage Plus | Total Device Protection | Home Theatre Premium | Major Appliance Extended Service | Business Fleet Protection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| replacement parts | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried |
| repair labour | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried |
| drops, knocks and cracks from handling | not carried | carried | carried | carried | not carried | carried |
| liquid ingress | not carried | carried | carried | not carried | not carried | carried |
| damage from a mains power surge | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried |
| a cracked screen or panel | not carried | carried | carried | carried | not carried | carried |
| theft of the covered item | not carried | not carried | carried | not carried | not carried | carried |
| a battery below the stated health floor | not carried | not carried | carried | not carried | not carried | carried |
| wear from ordinary use | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried |
| marks that do not affect function | not carried | not carried | carried | carried | not carried | not carried |
| a fault present before cover started | excluded | excluded | excluded | excluded | excluded | excluded |
| use of the item in a business | not carried | not carried | not carried | carried | not carried | carried |
| work carried out outside the country | not carried | not carried | carried | not carried | not carried | carried |

### Reading the table at a different granularity

Every plan carries parts, labour, wear from ordinary use and damage from a mains power surge,
and every plan excludes a fault the item already had before cover started. Theft and a
battery below its health floor are carried on ShieldCare Total Device Protection and
ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection alone. Cosmetic marks are carried on ShieldCare Total
Device Protection and ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium alone. Business use of the item is
carried on ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium and ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection alone,
and work outside the country on ShieldCare Total Device Protection and ShieldCare Business
Fleet Protection alone.
